notes.title: Sorbetta works on Steam Deck!
notes.notes:
That's pretty much it: I was able to test it on the Steam Deck and as far as I can tell, it's working flawlessly! If anyone has any issues, please let me know!

[i]Note: The game is still not compatible with Linux systems, and only works on the Steam Deck due to Proton.[/i]

notes.title: Sorbetta is going free...FOREVER!
notes.notes:
Yep. Sorbetta will be free as soon as Valve approves the change. It shouldn't take more than about a week, so if you're thinking about picking it up, hold off! (Unless you really want to support me, thanks!)

So, I'm sure a few of you have some questions. I'll do my best to answer them all:

[b]Why free, and why now?[/b]
Well, to be frank: the game has made back its initial investment. I made back the money I spent on it, and feel that it was, for all intents and purposes, a success. So as a way of saying thank you to those who have followed along with this little journey of mine, I'm releasing it for free. For always. I figured it was time. Honestly, I meant to do this exactly on the 2 year anniversary, but it slipped my mind.

[b]Just take the money and run? What about those who paid for it?[/b]
Well, unfortunately I can't really give them anything for being early supporters of this project and game, other than my deepest gratitude. And I feel that the game has hit an age that it's now about getting it out to as many people who will be interested in it. To those who did pay for it, and feel slighted/offended by this decision, I'm deeply and truly sorry. I hope you know that I'm doing this not to hurt you or belittle your financial support of this game.

[b]I guess that's fair. So what now?[/b]
I've put the request in to Valve, and now I simply have to wait for their approval. It could take up to a week for the new price to come into effect.

As for the future, I've got a couple of projects I'm currently working on, so who knows? Maybe something will be out by the end of the year if we're lucky! ;)

[b]Are you making the DLC free?[/b]
No. I feel that if people want to continue to show me support, they're free to purchase the wallpapers for the game's characters. I will NOT be increasing the price to compensate for the base game becoming free, either!


[i][b]Thank you all for supporting me in this game and my other creative endeavors. It means the world to me.[/b][/i]

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

It's been a little over TWO YEARS since this little game was released, and since I am going to be getting a Steam Deck I am going to try and do my best to update it so it will work on that! I still have all the original files so it may be as easy as porting it to Linux when compiling the game in RPG Maker MV. I'll be able to extensively test it out as well, so here's hoping it all goes well.

I will let you al, know how it turns out!

notes.title: Permanent Price Reduction!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Yep, after nine months on sale, Sorbetta is getting a 50% off price reduction! 

To everyone who has supported the game so far, you guys are AWESOME and I really appreciate the support and love you all have shown for me and my little game that 'could' (as far as being a decent game made with RTP, that is). 

What started as a means to show that [i][b]ANYONE[/b][/i] could make a decent RPG Maker game with a little time has turned into something special.

So, enjoy the price reduction!

notes.title: Sorbetta: Gravely in Debt is having its first ever Sale!
notes.notes:
It's our first ever sale! Even though the game was recently released, we couldn't pass up a chance to be part of the Steam Summer Sale! Enjoy a [b]HEFTY[/b] 40% discount from June 25th to July 9th!

Already own a copy? Pick up the DLC wallpapers (Now Updated with Summer Fun!) or tell your friends!!

notes.title: New Wallpapers Available!
notes.notes:
In celebration of Summer and to help get everyone's minds off these trying times, we're adding new wallpapers to our existing DLC! Hopefully these two new wallpapers will help you [i]cool[/i] off during this hot summer ;)

Please note: If it does not update automatically, please verify your game's installation, and/or re-download the DLC. The new wallpapers should show up.
